quote.text: I need a bill tracker that shows what I have paid

promise.text: Monthly bills list: amounts, dates and annual costs

art.why: the carousel's topic: the moment and its guide name "date", "annual"

lines.text: List every recurring commitment once, keep its real payment date, and separate a monthly planning amount from the money due next.

items.text: Gather recent statements from every account or card used for household bills.
Write each recurring commitment once, including subscriptions and required debt payments.
Check a longer history and renewal notices for quarterly, six-monthly and annual charges.
Record the next real due date, not just the month you remember paying last time.
Add the payment account, automatic or manual method, and any shared contribution.
Mark uncertain amounts or dates as unconfirmed and assign a lookup task.
